review.method: Unchanged English7.0.3 reviewed baseline plus independently reviewed source-backed suffix and three-sense supplement

rootSuffixSupplement.scope: Independent review of exact14 source-affix entries, all345 related-word references and three new word senses. Original source senses/origins/homonyms/licences compared; source snapshot row hashes/templates and dictionaryPOS independently checked. Manual semantic and bilingual review supplement mechanical checks. Not a full dictionary re-review or native-speaker certification.
